Christianity
Christianity is the largest faith group in the UK, with numerous sub-divisions. It is the religion
practised by the largest number of minority communities. No assumptions should be made about
the cultural and “racial” homogeneity of Christians.
Public worship is conducted in a wide variety of settings, ranging from very small groups of people
with no formal leadership to very large congregations with formal rituals.
The main Christian churches in the UK are:
